sections.title: What Zhatura is
sections.content: Zhatura is an AI-powered chess learning platform that helps players improve through playing, reviewing games, and guided practice. It combines chess play with learning support so that players can understand their games, reflect on their decisions, and improve over time.

sections.title: Who Zhatura is for
sections.content: Zhatura is designed for beginners, developing chess players, young learners, parents, chess coaches, and chess academies. Students use it to play and learn, parents use it to support and oversee learning, and coaches and academies use it to support player development.

sections.title: How Zhatura is different from a normal chess app
sections.content: Zhatura combines competitive play with explanations that help players learn how to think about their chess decisions. Its purpose is to make chess improvement understandable, encouraging, structured, and safe. The platform positions learning as play plus review plus guided learning plus practice plus safety — the goal is not only playing more games, but understanding what happened in those games.

sections.title: How Zhatura helps you improve
sections.content: Zhatura supports a simple improvement loop. Play: play chess against other players. Review: look back at completed games. Understand: see important moments and receive explanations. Practice: work on tactical exercises and relevant training. Improve: use lessons from previous games in future play.

Exact prices, plan names, and review limits are not verified in the knowledge base. Current pricing and detailed subscription information should be confirmed through Zhatura Customer Support.

sections.title: What the AI Chess Coach is
sections.content: The Zhatura AI Chess Coach is Zhatura's AI coach for learning chess. Children use the AI Chess Coach as part of the Zhatura learning platform. It exists alongside the Student, Parent and Coach Dashboards.

sections.title: My Zhatura Coach
sections.content: The AI coaching experience is called My Zhatura Coach. My Zhatura Coach helps players reflect on completed games. It provides supportive explanations and reflective questions that help players understand their decisions — why a move was played, what alternatives might have existed, what the player noticed, what the player may have missed, and how to improve similar decisions in future games. It is a learning aid and does not replace a human chess coach.

sections.title: What the AI Chess Coach can explain generally
sections.content: The AI Chess Coach supports a child's chess learning journey. It can explain chess concepts, point out mistakes and suggest what to focus on next during practice and review.

sections.title: Post-game learning focus
sections.content: Zhatura's AI coaching is designed for learning and post-game reflection, not for giving players moves during an active competitive game. My Zhatura Coach does not provide a move, the best move, or any move suggestions while you are playing a competitive game. Its coaching focuses on a small number of meaningful moments after a game instead of overwhelming learners with every possible chess mistake, so the learner can focus on the most useful moments from a game.

sections.title: What is documented today
sections.content: Current documented capabilities — online chess, matchmaking, ratings, game analysis, My Zhatura Coach, training and puzzles, game history, guardian controls and safety features — are described in their own knowledge entries. Keep future plans clearly separated from current documented capabilities.

faqs.question: What is the Zhatura AI Chess Coach?
faqs.answer: The Zhatura AI Chess Coach is Zhatura's AI coach for learning chess. It explains chess concepts, points out mistakes, and recommends better ideas during practice and game review. The coaching experience is called My Zhatura Coach.

faqs.question: What is My Zhatura Coach?
faqs.answer: My Zhatura Coach helps players reflect on completed games with supportive explanations and reflective questions. It does not provide moves during an active competitive game.

faqs.question: Can I play chess against other players?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura documentation describes online one-on-one chess games through matchmaking or direct challenges, including competitive player-versus-player games.

faqs.question: Does Zhatura have matchmaking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura includes skill-based matchmaking intended to help players find opponents with comparable playing strength, so games are more balanced and useful.

faqs.question: Does Zhatura use player ratings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura includes player ratings for rated games to help players track competitive progress over time. The rating formula and brackets are not documented.

faqs.question: Does Zhatura give moves during live games?
faqs.answer: No. Zhatura's AI coaching is designed for learning and post-game reflection, not for giving players moves during an active competitive game.

faqs.question: Can parents review their child's activity?
faqs.answer: Zhatura documentation describes guardian controls that include managing consent, reviewing activity, and controlling access to protected features.

faqs.question: Does Zhatura support safety controls for young players?
faqs.answer: Yes. Documented safety-oriented features include private profiles, restricted communication, reporting, and blocking, alongside guardian controls.

faqs.question: Can I use Zhatura on mobile?
faqs.answer: Zhatura is designed for chess play and learning on Android and iOS. Specific app-store release status is not verified.

faqs.question: What future features are planned?
faqs.answer: Future plans described for Zhatura include tournaments, expanded academy management, smart-board connections, and video coaching classrooms. These are roadmap items, not current capabilities.

faqs.question: How do students log into Zhatura?
faqs.answer: Students sign in directly through the Student Dashboard. For individual account access issues, please reach out to Zhatura Customer Support.

faqs.question: Can parents track their child's chess learning progress?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura includes a dedicated Parent Dashboard where parents can follow their child's chess learning journey.

faqs.question: What features are available for Chess Coaches and Academies?
faqs.answer: Coaches manage student batches through the Coach Dashboard. Zhatura also offers solutions for chess academies and educational organizations under Zhatura Chess Academy.

faqs.question: Where can I find current pricing and subscription plan details?
faqs.answer: For current plan or pricing information, please contact Zhatura Customer Support directly at 044-47615470. Our team will provide up-to-date plan details and answer any questions.

faqs.question: Which languages does Zhatura Customer Support speak?
faqs.answer: Our customer support line can converse in English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, and Odia.

faqs.question: Can customer support modify or view my private password?
faqs.answer: No. Zhatura customer support never asks for passwords, OTPs, or sensitive payment credentials on calls or via support messages.

faqs.question: Frequently Asked Questions
What is Zhatura?
faqs.answer: Zhatura is an AI-powered chess learning platform for students, children, parents, chess coaches, chess academies and organizations. It helps players improve by combining online chess, game review, guided coaching and practice.

faqs.question: Who is Zhatura designed for?
faqs.answer: Zhatura is designed for beginners, developing chess players, young learners, parents, chess coaches and chess academies. Students use it to play and learn, parents to support and oversee learning, and coaches and academies to support player development.

faqs.question: Can Zhatura help beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura is designed to help beginners and developing players improve through playing, reviewing games, guided coaching and practice, with explanations that are understandable and encouraging rather than only engine numbers.

faqs.question: Can children use Zhatura?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura is designed for young learners and includes safety-focused features such as private profiles, restricted communication, reporting and blocking, together with guardian controls for parents and guardians.

faqs.question: Can Zhatura analyze my games?
faqs.answer: Yes. After a game, Zhatura can help players review important decisions, missed opportunities and turning points. The purpose is learning — understanding what happened and why — rather than only showing mistakes.

faqs.question: Does Zhatura include puzzles or training?
faqs.answer: Yes. Documented capabilities include tactical exercises, chess practice, puzzles for training, and training connected to mistakes from previous games. Exact puzzle counts, difficulty levels and daily limits are not documented.

faqs.question: Can I review old games?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura allows players to revisit previous matches and their associated learning feedback. Game history can help players review earlier games, revisit coaching feedback, recognize recurring mistakes and observe improvement over time.

faqs.question: Does Zhatura have free access?
faqs.answer: Zhatura documentation describes free access: free accounts may receive limited coaching reviews. Exact review limits are not verified. Current pricing and detailed subscription information should be confirmed through Zhatura Customer Support.

faqs.question: Does Zhatura offer paid subscriptions?
faqs.answer: Zhatura documentation describes paid subscriptions that may provide expanded access. Plan names, exact prices and exact limits are not verified. Current pricing and detailed subscription information should be confirmed through Zhatura Customer Support.

faqs.question: Is Zhatura suitable for coaches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura is designed to support chess coaching workflows and player development. Coaches manage batches in the Coach Dashboard, and students learn through online play, game review and guided practice. Detailed coach-dashboard functions beyond batch management are not documented.

faqs.question: Is Zhatura suitable for chess academies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zhatura is designed to support chess academies and organized learning environments, with coaches managing batches in the Coach Dashboard. Academy seat limits, pricing and detailed management features are not documented.

faqs.question: Who is Zhatura for?
faqs.answer: Zhatura serves students and children learning chess, parents who want to follow their child's learning, chess coaches, chess academies and similar organizations.

faqs.question: Can I talk to a human support representative?
faqs.answer: A caller can always ask for human support and the request is acknowledged. Live transfer to a human agent is not enabled on this phone line yet; the support flow handles escalation once telephony transfer is enabled in a later phase.

faqs.question: How do students log in?
faqs.answer: Students log in through the Student Dashboard. For sign-in problems with a specific account, the assistant cannot access accounts yet and should route the caller to the support team.

faqs.question: Which languages does this support line speak?
faqs.answer: The support line can converse in English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi and Odia, and understands more Indian languages.

faqs.question: Can the support agent access my account?
faqs.answer: No. The assistant cannot log into, view, check or modify any individual customer account, child profile, subscription, payment or lesson/session status in the current phase.

faqs.question: How much does Zhatura cost?
faqs.answer: Exact pricing is not in the verified knowledge base. Never invent a price. Current pricing and detailed subscription information should be confirmed through Zhatura Customer Support.
